title: UX26: preserve topic and locality across follow-up questions (T03/T05)
body:
## Outcome
A follow-up to an A2 or Gympie answer retains the relevant conversational scope and coverage caveat instead of silently switching to generic support.

## Delivery
Status: In progress — Nissan dispatched Codex on 8 November 2026 (Australia/Sydney).
Builder: Codex; run `codex-45-20261108`; branch `feat/45-bounded-continuity`; base `0a7d9a6d1184e46042a299d44e0e1d54b8c8cf60`.
Reviewer: Claude (separate session); verifier: OpenAI/OpenClaw (separate session).
Ownership: continuity-related application/API/contracts/tests and scoped design notes. Claude retains data/sources under #28. Verification lane owns separate evidence reports; no concurrent product edits.
Priority: P1 / high journey impact
Evidence: fresh synthetic actors T03-base (`t03`) and T05-base (`t05`) in OpenClaw's 7 November follow-up; published reports and screenshots are being preserved in PR #43 at `research/synthetic-ux/runs/ux26-openclaw-20261107/published/followup/`. Attempt identities remain those in the reports, not the later integration head.

## Reproductions
1. T03: ask “I have a prototype and early customer discussions. Help me work out what needs attention before I apply for Round A2 today.” Inspect the sourced/editorial steps. Replace with the registered follow-up “Which step is required now, which is a suggestion, and what is still unknown?” It asks jurisdiction and, after Queensland selection, substitutes generic Program B/support routes. Repeating A2 restores the topic. Evidence: t03-06 through t03-10 and t03-actor.html.
2. T05, 390×844: ask “I am building a software prototype in Gympie. I need a local or remote support route, not a long national list.” The initial answer correctly limits Gympie coverage. Replace with “If there is no evidence for my area, show the next useful place to check.” After a state prompt and Queensland selection it drops the Gympie limitation and shows generic Queensland routes. Evidence: t05-03 through t05-06 and t05-actor.html.

Observed UI behavior, not evidence of human misunderstanding or live-source correctness. These reproductions share a continuity problem; they are one finding, not two duplicates. The 19px directory overflow is separately fixed in #43 and does not resolve continuity.

## Acceptance
- Choose and document a bounded continuity model before implementation; preserve explicit structured Unknown and do not infer confirmed founder facts from prose.
- Preserve or explicitly reconfirm the referenced topic/locality on these follow-ups; never quietly replace an unsupported-locality caveat with a statewide match.
- A deliberate new unrelated question can leave the prior topic, avoiding stale context contamination.
- Review any contract/session changes explicitly; no hidden production memory or unbounded retention.
- Add regressions for both exact follow-ups, explicit Unknown and deliberate topic switches.
- Retest both tasks at a pinned new head with separate primed regression and fresh actor evidence; retain original partial outcomes.

Refs #26, #27, #43. This issue does not close the first research round.
